page_title: CRY 2-2 LEI | Crystal Palace v Leicester 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The ball is crossed into the box and Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the right side of the goal, but Mads Hermansen gets a glove on it to thwart him.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mads Hermansen into the bottom right corner.
90+2' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+1' Conor Coady (Leicester) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul after Conor Coady (Leicester) hacks down one of his opponents. Crystal Palace are about to take a penalty!
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Tyrick Mitchell cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
87' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
87' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
86' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
84' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
83' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Jordan Ayew is replaced by Conor Coady (Leicester).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) comes onto the pitch so that Daniel Munoz can be given a rest.
81' Wout Faes (Leicester) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Caution goes to Jordan Ayew (Leicester).
78' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Wilfred Ndidi as he is replaced by Hamza Choudhury (Leicester).
76' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
75' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
75' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Substitution. Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) has come on for Stephy Mavididi.
71' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Oliver Skipp (Leicester), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
70' Dean Henderson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
69' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
67' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
66' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' Oliver Glasner has decided to make a change. Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) replaces Nathaniel Clyne.
63' The ball is cleared after Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
61' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
60' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) was too forceful with his tackle and Tony Harrington interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
59' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is flagged for offside.
58' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
55' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
52' Tony Harrington shows the yellow card to Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) for a heavy challenge.
51' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Crystal Palace players have a reason to celebrate!
48' Wait! Referee Tony Harrington has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

48' 1 - 2 Goal! Tyrick Mitchell produces a great pass that finds Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
46' 0 - 2 Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top left corner.
46' Substitution. Cheick Doucoure makes way for Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A corner kick by Leicester is thwarted by the well prepared Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace).
45+1' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' Crystal Palace are seeing far more of the ball now.
38' Wout Faes (Leicester) jumps into a tackle and Tony Harrington signals a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick.
37' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

35' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
34' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
33' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

33' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
32' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
31' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
28' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the bottom right corner and Mads Hermansen easily makes the save.
26' The game is interrupted now, Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
25' Caleb Okoli (Leicester) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
25' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) takes the corner.

24' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Leicester will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Crystal Palace fail to score from a corner as Mads Hermansen (Leicester) leaps to collect the ball.

23' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
21' 0 - 1 Jamie Vardy (Leicester) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.

20' Mads Hermansen makes a brilliant save! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
20' He should have scored! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
19' Good defending. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) tries to find Daniel Munoz inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
16' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
15' The free kick from long range, taken by Leicester, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
13' A loose ball is pounced on by Jordan Ayew (Leicester) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson is alert and makes a comfortable save.
12' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
11' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
10' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) is penalised for holding. Tony Harrington signals a set piece.
8' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Tony Harrington interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace).
5' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
3' Good clearance! Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
2' Some great controlled play and passing from Leicester. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tony Harrington.
